description: Back up a registered foreign Postgres database with pg_dump into the operator's workspace. format plain (SQL script, the vendor default), custom, directory or tar; output_path is an ABSOLUTE path under a saved location. Every pg_dump option is a parameter named after its long flag (schema, exclude_schema, table, exclude_table_data, schema_only, data_only, clean, if_exists, create, no_owner, no_privileges, compress, jobs, section, inserts, role and the rest). The password reaches pg_dump through a private temporary password file only. pg_dump is found in client_bin_dir, then PATH, then the standard PostgreSQL directories. Returns a queued job; the result has output_path, format, bytes and pg_dump's messages.
embedding_description: Back up an external Postgres database to a file with pg_dump: whole database, chosen schemas or tables, schema only or data only, as a plain SQL script or a custom, directory or tar archive for pg_restore. Every pg_dump option is available. The dump file lands in the operator's workspace and can be restored to another server.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dispatch envelope: job_id (string) and status ('queued'). The outcome arrives when the job completes: {output_path, format, bytes, messages}, where messages is pg_dump's stderr with the host removed (empty unless verbose or warnings).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: This call only confirms the job was queued. Once delivered, report the dump path, format and size, and mention restore_database for restoring it (custom, directory and tar archives through pg_restore; a plain SQL dump is not restorable there, so dump with format custom when a restore is planned). Never inline the dump's contents.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Dump a registered foreign Postgres database to a workspace file with pg_dump.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: external_pg.client_tool_missing: pg_dump is not in client_bin_dir, on PATH, or in the standard PostgreSQL directories. external_pg.client_tool_failed: pg_dump exited non-zero; the message carries its stderr with the host removed (for example a server version mismatch, or a pattern that matched nothing with strict_names). external_pg.export_path_refused: the path must be absolute, have the required suffix where specified, and lie under a saved path address, the session folder or solet home, outside the installation tree. Input files must already exist. external_pg.invalid_params: an unknown format, a wrongly typed option, or a missing parent directory. external_pg.auth_failed / external_pg.api_error: authentication or connection failed (fixed messages without topology). external_pg.permission_denied: the role cannot read an object being dumped. external_pg.timeout: pg_dump ran longer than client_tool_timeout_seconds.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: external_pg.client_tool_missing: install the PostgreSQL client programs or set client_bin_dir in the plugin config. external_pg.client_tool_failed naming a version mismatch: point client_bin_dir at a pg_dump at least as new as the server. external_pg.export_path_refused: ask "where will you save this?" and use the returned folder, or say "save exports for <project> in <folder>" to save a project location. Keep it outside the installation tree; input files must already exist. external_pg.permission_denied: dump fewer objects (schema, table, exclude_table) or ask the operator for the GRANT. external_pg.timeout: raise client_tool_timeout_seconds or dump less.
